items.title: AWS Emulator: AI Agents Built a Full AWS Clone From Scratch
items.summary: AI agents built a free, CC0-licensed AWS emulator covering 200+ services, generated from 400+ Smithy API models and validated against real AWS through agent-written fidelity tests. A four-month manual rebuild of AWS's internal replication engine took one agent about two hours once it had a spec and test harness to check against. Full commit history and known gaps are public on GitHub, so teams can point agents at the same harness today. (4 minute read)

items.title: Silent Lynx Ran an Open-Source AI Agent Against Central Asian Govts
items.summary: Silent Lynx ran Hermes, an open-source AI agent on DeepSeek set up as an 'offensive cybersecurity expert,' for recon and cleanup, controlled remotely via Telegram in Russian. Using one railway employee's credentials, it held access to Tajikistan's national network for two months, pulling Defense Ministry files and data from 100+ government agencies. CloudSEK found the campaign via a 12GB+ exposed server. (4 minute read)

items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen Runs Agentic Tasks 2.5x Faster
items.summary: Gemini 4 Hydrogen finishes agentic tasks 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash, with partners seeing 12-23% fewer tokens on complex workflows, at $1.50/$7.50 per million input/output tokens over a 1M-token context. It scores 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1 versus 18.2% for 3.8 Flash, with agentic overreach down 81% and 2.3x more resistance to indirect prompt injection. It's rolling out now in Search, the Gemini app, and Antigravity. (4 minute read)

items.title: Weight Fingerprints Show Chinese Models Trained on Blackwell GPUs
items.summary: A forensic method recovers the PyTorch RNG seed and GPU thread count baked into a model's untouched initial weights, since thread count tracks a chip's SM count. Five 2026 Chinese models — DeepSeek-V4-Flash/Pro, Kimi K3/K3.1-Pro, MiniMax-M3, Ling-3.1-flash — match Blackwell's 148-152 SM layout at 49-1,385 sigma against an 8-sigma chance baseline, agreeing with all 24 disclosed-hardware cases checked. It can't show how the GPUs were obtained. (4 minute read)

items.title: Gemini Decisions API Scores Options Instead of Generating Text
items.summary: The Gemini Decisions API scores up to 1,000 yes/no, multiple-choice, or rubric questions against one multimodal input in a single pass, returning a 0-1 confidence score instead of generated text. It answers in 150-250ms at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0 for output — about 5x cheaper than Flash-Lite on Google's benchmark suite. Gemini Notebook reports 40% lower latency using it as a model router. (4 minute read)

items.title: LLMON Markup Cuts Prompt Injection by Up to 95% in Granite
items.summary: LLMON tags prompt structure with reserved delimiter tokens so instructions stay bound to specific data instead of blending into free text. On the OPI benchmark it blocks 47% more injection attacks than the best frontier model tested and 95% more than the best open model, while matching base Granite 4.1 Instruct on general capability. Two preview models and the conversion toolkit are on GitHub now. (4 minute read)

items.title: Edge0-145B Runs Frontier-Level Coding Benchmarks on a Laptop
items.summary: Edge0-145B is a 145B-parameter MoE model with only 10B active per step, released with open weights and an inference framework that runs in 29GB of memory on a laptop GPU. It beats Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and DeepSeek-V4-Flash on DeepSWE 1.1 (64.6) and Terminal-Bench 2.1 (86.52), decoding at 80+ tokens/sec and prefilling at 1,100+ tokens/sec. It runs on Apple M-series chips and RTX 4090/5090 cards today. (4 minute read)

items.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Cyber for Cybersecurity Agents
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a model line built specifically for aligned cybersecurity agents. (1 minute read)
